decisions.reason: Image rendering is an independent behavior already addressed by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the source Requirement's information-display change requires no additional candidate update.
The source concerns metadata information in Rabby's wallet NFT view, not whether successfully minted NFTs appear accurately in the dashboard inventory.
Displaying NFT information in a wallet does not change the required accuracy of public mint statistics.
The wallet metadata display requirement does not alter the public prize-draw countdown or its underlying measure.
The source does not change how referral commissions are shown in the dashboard.
The source does not require any change to prize-ticket assignment or dashboard visibility.
The FAQ's references to NFT metadata are descriptive content and are not changed by the wallet metadata rendering requirement.
The source does not modify referral commission triggers, recipients, amounts, or payout behavior.
Using NFT metadata as an ebook viewer entry point remains valid unchanged; wallet display of NFT information does not modify reader navigation.
The source concerns wallet metadata presentation and does not change any About page content.
Wallet display of NFT metadata does not affect Chainlink VRF selection, eligibility, weighting, or verification.
The source reports wallet presentation and custom-token import behavior after minting, not a change to the deferred Transak fiat conversion and mint flow.
